text: BAM share fell 0.05 percentage points over 21 hours and 0.37 percentage points over 7 days, leaving 37.5% of Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3, and the largest node holds 26.2% of BAM stake. Recent leadership movement should be read as whale-driven routing, not a structural rollover; only the fra rollover has been validated, with 22 minutes of lead time.
